description: Implement tag and release management in GCT API: GET /api/v1/repo/tags (list tags), POST /api/v1/repo/tags (create annotated tag), POST /api/v1/repo/release/draft (generate release notes), POST /api/v1/repo/release/create (publish GitHub release with notes and assets), GET /api/v1/repo/releases (list releases). Same GitHub client interface and mock testing as PR endpoints.
name: gct-github-release-api
title: Tag operations and GitHub release create/list/publish endpoints
